en: A vintage black‑and‑white postcard showing a wide, tree‑lined street with early 20th‑century multi‑story stone buildings on the left, including a corner building with steep spires and ornate detailing. People and a cart are faintly visible in the distance. Printed captions at the bottom read the place name and the street name, with a handwritten message in Swedish across the lower margin.
